dabc1f4471827281.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Chief Steward to manage daily kitchen utility operations and staff in Dammam. This full-time role involves overseeing dish room operations, night cleaning, back dock maintenance, banquet plating, and food running. The Chief Steward will supervise kitchen employees not actively engaged in cooking, focusing on improving guest and employee satisfaction while adhering to the operating budget. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day kitchen utility operations, including ordering and managing necessary supplies, equipment, tools, and uniforms. Schedule events, programs, activities, and staff work. Monitor the inflow and maintenance of ordered materials. Conduct inventories of china, glass, silver, food, equipment, smallware, and liquor, reporting any shortages. Inspect supplies, equipment, and work areas to ensure efficient service and adherence to standards. Investigate and follow up on employee accidents. Oversee all equipment, china, glass, and silver, ensuring adequate clean supplies. Supervise employees to ensure compliance with loss prevention policies, proper cleaning routines for serviceware, equipment, and floors, and correct use of dish room machinery. Ensure all food holding and transport equipment is in working order. Ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, food handling, and sanitation standards. Communicate relevant information to executives, peers, and subordinates in a timely manner. Supervise and manage employees, understanding their roles to perform duties in their absence. Provide leadership, vision, and direction to prioritize departmental goals efficiently and effectively. Maintain employee productivity levels and serve as a role model for appropriate behaviors. Achieve and exceed performance, budget, and team goals. Recognize team members' contributions and foster mutual trust, respect, and cooperation. Communicate performance expectations and establish collaborative relationships with employees. Participate in managing departmental controllable expenses to meet or exceed budgeted goals. Strive to improve service performance and solicit employee feedback. Understand the impact of department operations on overall property financial goals and objectives. Customer Service Excellence Attend meetings and communicate with executives, peers, and subordinates to enhance service quality. Manage daily operations, ensuring quality, standards, and customer expectations are met. Emphasize guest satisfaction in all departmental meetings and promote continuous improvement. Human Resources Management Provide guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance. Participate in recruiting, interviewing, selecting, hiring, and promoting employees. Train employees in safety procedures and provide feedback based on service behavior observations. Review employee satisfaction results to identify and address concerns. Ensure disciplinary procedures and documentation comply with Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process. Administer property policies fairly and consistently. Ensure utility staff is properly trained in sanitation, equipment handling, and chemical usage. Participate in employee progressive discipline procedures. About the Team As part of the Sheraton family, you will join a global community that has fostered gathering and connection since 1937. Sheraton associates create a sense of belonging in over 400 communities worldwide by inviting, welcoming, and connecting guests through engaging experiences and thoughtful service. This role is an opportunity to contribute to Sheraton's mission to be 'The World’s Gathering Place' and to be part of Marriott International's portfolio of brands, where you can achieve your best work and grow professionally.

da37075116dac28d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخطوط السعوديه للخدمات الطبيه عن أخصائي تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم رعاية تمريضية شاملة للمرضى، بدءًا من التقييم وحتى تنفيذ خطط الرعاية وتوثيقها. الغرض من الوظيفة يتولى أخصائي التمريض مسؤولية إعداد خطط الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييمها. يشمل الدور أخذ العلامات الحيوية والعينات اللازمة للفحوصات المخبرية، وإعطاء الأدوية والعقاقير وفقًا لتعليمات الطبيب المعالج، بالإضافة إلى توثيق جميع الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية في السجل الطبي للمريض. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم الوضع الصحي للمريض وجمع البيانات من المريض وذويه وتوثيقها وتحليلها، وتحديد احتياجات المريض من الرعاية. إعداد خطة الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها بشكل مستمر. أخذ العلامات الحيوية للمريض وعينات الدم والبول والبراز لإجراء الفحوصات المخبرية بحسب تعليمات الطبيب المعالج. متابعة إرسال العينات للمختبر والحصول على النتائج وإعلام الطبيب المعالج بها. إعطاء الأدوية والعقاقير الطبية والمحاليل الوريدية بحسب تعليمات الطبيب المعالج. المشاركة في عملية الإنعاش القلبي والرئوي عند الحاجة. توثيق الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية المقدمة للمريض في السجل الطبي. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال وعمليات التمريض. تطوير العمل يتوقع من أخصائي التمريض المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات المستمرة في أساليب التمريض والرعاية التمريضية لضمان تقديم أفضل مستويات الخدمة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التمريض. القدرة على إعداد خطط الرعاية التمريضية وتقييمها. معرفة بإجراءات أخذ العينات الحيوية والمخبرية. القدرة على إعطاء الأدوية والمحاليل الوريدية بدقة. مهارات توثيق ممتازة للسجلات الطبية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الرعاية الصحية في جدة، مكة المكرمة، ويتطلب الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في بيئة طبية.

da539dcfeca7378c.job_title: Lead Product Service Engineer Controls Platform HMI & Network
da539dcfeca7378c.description: About the Role GE Vernova is seeking a Lead Product Service Engineer for Controls Platform HMI & Network. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Eastern region, and involves providing direct technical support to global GE Vernova Gas Power customers. The role focuses on resolving technical inquiries, leading complex issue investigations, and communicating technical guidance to both customers and internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Provide technical resolution for complex Controls system issues, including Mark VI/VIe Product line, Human Machine Interface (HMI) platform, Industrial communication interfaces (Modbus, Foundation Fieldbus, OPC, Profibus, CAN bus, EGD), historians, and industrial cyber security at power plants. Identify trending issues and develop countermeasures to protect customer fleets, communicating these to relevant audiences through channels such as TILs, PSxBs, ETCs, and OnTheGo alerts. Collaborate with Design Engineering, Product Management, Regional Customer Engineering Centers, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Vendors, and customers to deliver timely technical resolutions. Lead complex Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations, driving root cause identification and corrective actions, while communicating findings internally to field teams and GE Vernova leadership, and externally to end customers. Promote GE Vernova Way traits, lean principles, and simplification in daily activities. Technical Support Focus Areas Resolve customer technical inquiries and mentor team members through engineering request (ER) cases. Lead or participate in complex issue resolution involving Power Plant Control Systems, HMIs, Networks, and associated product Cyber Security root cause analysis (RCA) investigations for high business impact issues, often working with cross-functional teams. Communicate GE Vernova technical guidance to customers or site representatives via user conferences, customer webinars, and technical documents. Additionally, communicate technical details and business risks to GE Vernova internal stakeholders. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in product service engineering, particularly with control platforms, HMIs, and network systems in a power generation context. The role requires a strong technical background in industrial control systems and communication protocols. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, within the Eastern region. The role involves working with global customers and cross-functional internal teams to address critical technical challenges in the gas power sector. Application Process Salary details for this position are not disclosed. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply directly through the company's official channels.

dacb3a7a3e7f4c4c.description: About the Role Soum is seeking a Vehicle Inspection Specialist to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role is critical to ensuring that every vehicle delivered meets the promised condition. The specialist will be responsible for providing accurate technical assessments of vehicles, from initial inspection to post-sale issue resolution, and will support the Cars Operations team with various tasks. Key Responsibilities Conduct initial inspections of vehicles, assessing body, exterior, interior, and overall condition against Soum's checklist. Evaluate mechanical and electrical components, including engine, transmission, suspension, brakes, steering, and electrical systems. Identify and document any damage, defects, previous repairs, or discrepancies. Produce clear and accurate inspection reports, including photographs of vehicle condition and any defects found. Record all findings, reports, and photos in the system for Sales and After-Sales teams. Perform final pre-handover inspections to confirm the vehicle matches its report and includes all accessories (keys, manual, spare tyre). Assess technical issues raised in post-sale warranty requests and complaints, determining cause and recommending fixes. Document technical findings for the After-Sales Customer Experience Specialist to communicate with customers. Brief approved maintenance workshops on technical findings and required work, and review completed repairs. Coordinate with the Operations team throughout the vehicle journey and support other operational tasks as needed. Vehicle Handover Support Confirm the car has passed its pre-handover check and all accessories are present before appointments. Walk customers through the car's condition and inspection report, and introduce key features. Document the handover process with the customer, including signing forms and taking photos. Qualifications and Requirements Demonstrated knowledge of and hands-on experience in car inspection. Ability to inspect a vehicle's body, exterior, interior, and overall condition thoroughly. Good automotive knowledge, including understanding car components and how to assess their condition. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in identifying vehicle issues. Flexibility and willingness to support various operational tasks. Preferred Skills and Experience Previous experience inspecting used cars. Experience using diagnostic tools and scanners. Experience in writing inspection reports or using digital inspection systems.

daf05555796ac67d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مشاتل العاصمه الحديثه عن كهربائي سيارات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الجبيل. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية في السيارات، مما يضمن كفاءة عملها وسلامتها. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفسير المخططات الأولية وتركيب الأنظمة الكهربائية ومعدات السيارات بدقة. فحص الأجزاء الفردية والمجمعة جزئياً والكاملة لضمان الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والمواصفات الفنية. إجراء أعمال الصيانة الوقائية للأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية، وتحديد المشكلات والأعطال المحتملة قبل تفاقمها. تنفيذ الخدمات اللازمة للأنظمة الكهربائية والمعدات في السيارات وإصلاحها، بما في ذلك أجهزة القياس، معدات الإضاءة، والمولدات. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع الأوقات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات ككهربائي سيارات. فهم جيد للمخططات الكهربائية للسيارات والقدرة على تفسيرها. مهارة في استخدام أدوات الفحص والإصلاح الكهربائي. بيئة العمل يعمل كهربائي السيارات ضمن فريق في مشاتل العاصمه الحديثه بالجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لتنفيذ المهام الموكلة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في مشاتل العاصمه الحديثه.

da167a7755f21e93.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الجابري اخوان للنقليات عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة المستندات المالية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وإعداد التقارير المحاسبية بدقة. يتطلب الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المحاسبية. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها بشكل منظم. تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها للصرف من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. فهم قوي للمبادئ المحاسبية وإجراءات التدقيق المالي. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المالية وتحليل البيانات المحاسبية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة والقدرة على إدارة المستندات المالية بدقة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم البيانات المالية. الالتزام بالدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في جميع المهام المحاسبية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، وتوفر فرصة للعمل في بيئة مهنية داعمة ضمن شركة الجابري اخوان للنقليات. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

da38e7f7d446e577.description: Chief Financial Officer, Healthcare Lobo Management is seeking a Chief Financial Officer for an established healthcare provider in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the financial strategy, operations, and performance for a provider specializing in non-acute and long-term healthcare services, including rehabilitation, long-term mechanical ventilation, renal dialysis, and mental health services. Role Overview Reporting directly to the CEO, the Chief Financial Officer will serve as a strategic business partner, ensuring profitability, liquidity, optimal capital structure, and long-term financial sustainability. The role oversees financial planning and analysis, accounting, revenue cycle management, treasury, lender relationships, taxation, financial controls, and performance optimization. This position also leads the financial workstream for organizational growth initiatives, including evaluating new healthcare facilities, capital investments, development projects, and financing arrangements. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the hospital's financial strategy in alignment with operational objectives and long-term business plans. Lead annual budgeting, financial forecasting, long-term financial planning, and financial performance reviews; present results to the Board and Audit Committee. Partner with the CEO and senior management to identify opportunities for improving profitability, operational efficiency, and financial sustainability. Provide strategic financial advice on business performance, resource allocation, investments, and commercial decisions. Develop and monitor financial and operational KPIs, providing actionable analysis and recommendations. Establish effective financial controls, cost allocation methodologies, and performance reporting across hospital departments. Manage working capital, liquidity, and cash flow forecasting to ensure appropriate financial resources. Oversee financial accounting, statutory reporting, financial governance, and internal controls in accordance with IFRS. Lead annual external audits, coordinate with auditors, and ensure timely submission of statutory financial statements and regulatory filings. Support the CEO in evaluating business expansion opportunities, including new hospitals and healthcare facilities. Lead or contribute to financial feasibility studies, investment appraisals, and business cases for new healthcare projects. Oversee capital expenditure planning, budgeting, and financial monitoring for hospital infrastructure and development projects. Evaluate potential financing structures and funding requirements for capital investments and expansion initiatives. Oversee treasury operations, cash flow management, liquidity planning, and financial risk management. Oversee the effective integration and utilization of Hospital Information Systems (HIS), ERP platforms, patient billing systems, and revenue cycle management technologies. Drive automation, financial reporting improvements, and data-driven decision-making through digital tools. Lead, manage, and develop the hospital's finance function, ensuring strong financial controls and operational effectiveness. Candidate Requirements Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline. Professional qualifications such as CA, ACCA, CPA, or CMA are preferred. Over 10 years of progressive finance experience, including senior financial leadership within hospitals or healthcare organizations. Proven experience within long-term care, rehabilitation, post-acute care, or specialist healthcare facilities. Sound knowledge of Saudi Arabian financial reporting, statutory audit, taxation, and regulatory requirements. Demonstrated experience in banking relationships, treasury management, and corporate financing. Strong experience in hospital financial management, budgeting, financial planning, revenue cycle management, treasury, and financial controls. Exposure to capital expenditure planning, investment appraisals, financial feasibility studies, and development projects. Experience supporting hospital expansion, greenfield healthcare developments, or major capital investment projects is an advantage. Strong proficiency in healthcare information systems, ERP platforms, billing systems, and financial reporting technologies. Commercially astute, analytical, and capable of partnering with clinical and operational leadership to improve business performance. Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates on a full-time basis within a healthcare provider focused on specialized non-acute and long-term care services.

da73e09802669b48.description: About HSBC Saudi Arabia HSBC Saudi Arabia provides investment banking services to a diverse range of corporate and institutional clients within both the private and government sectors. This includes public and private companies, funds, government agencies, and family businesses and offices. Role Purpose The Client Management Manager leads the Client Management team, which is responsible for the onboarding of institutional clients across Brokerage, HSS, and Investment Banking. These clients are often high-profile, ranging from local and regional Sovereign Wealth Funds to significant local Government entities and international global custodian banks and broker-dealers. The role requires effective communication and management of these clients throughout the onboarding experience, while also engaging with senior stakeholders internally across Product, Legal, Risk, and Compliance within HBSA. The job holder must be proficient in local Capital Market Authority rules and regulations, as well as HBSA's internal AML CDD policies and procedures, and capable of making risk-based decisions regarding CDD and policy application. This role is full-time. Key Responsibilities Lead all onboarding requests for GBM relationship and product teams, acting as the operational point of contact for clients regarding onboarding requirements. Serve as the interface between the HSBC SA Middle Office team, relevant product teams, and clients for onboarding and ongoing KYC refreshers. Coordinate the collection of additional information from clients to support downstream HSBC SA Middle Office functions. Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders including shared services, Front Office, IT, Legal, and Compliance to enhance client experience. Provide support for complaints management within the GBM business. Coordinate regular meetings with internal stakeholders (*, Middle Office, Compliance, Legal) to discuss service levels and turnaround times. Lead discussions and negotiations with clients in conjunction with the HSBC SA Legal team. Act as a coordination point with HSBC and SABB RM and product teams for client onboarding and reviews. Develop and maintain the GBM client tracker, including KYC refresher dates. Ensure team members (Client Management analysts) perform duties in line with agreed procedures. Assist with other projects as agreed with the COO GBM. Operational Effectiveness and Control Contribute to improvements in customer service, quality, and team collaboration. Adhere to HSBC policies, procedures, and control requirements, escalating concerns promptly. Apply administrative policies and standards to tasks, ensuring high quality, effective risk management, and regulatory compliance. Ensure clients are assigned the correct Financial Crime Risk Rating to drive refresher processes and enable AML/Sanctions screening and monitoring. Ensure refreshers are completed on time and client notifications are sent within regulatory timelines to mitigate reputational, regulatory, and financial risks. Implement robust controls around internal procedures, focusing on ongoing process improvements, capacity creation, and cost reduction. Play a key role in activities associated with Minerva and the Group. Leadership and Teamwork Support HSBC's vision, values, goals, and culture through personal behavior and decision-making. Take responsibility for understanding performance expectations, completing mandatory training, and developing necessary capabilities. Contribute to team development and success by sharing knowledge and collaborating to foster a productive and supportive work environment. Required Attributes and Performance Standards Ability to meet deadlines and complete work to the required standard on time. Work processed accurately according to established procedures. Capability to respond to relevant queries without referral or escalation. Effective communication of escalated queries with sufficient context and background. Accurate maintenance and updating of files and records. Adherence to procedures related to confidential information. Diligence throughout all aspects of the onboarding process. Ensuring risk items reach a conclusion by the appropriate function or product partner during onboarding.

dab36d6ed6c95070.description: About the Role UCC Holding is seeking a Construction Manager FIT OUT to oversee and coordinate all construction activities in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role ensures projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. The Construction Manager will lead the construction team, manage subcontractors and resources, and ensure compliance with safety regulations and building codes. The position involves problem-solving and decision-making to address issues throughout the construction process. Key Responsibilities Manage all project-related cost controls by collecting, analyzing, and advising management on appropriate courses of action based on cost efficiency and capability. Establish and maintain line item costs for all associated preliminaries and consumables projected over the project period. Strategize, manage, and develop all relevant approaches to ensure the delivery of project earnings. Maintain the quality and value of all services and goods to minimize cash tied up in inventory and ensure the flow of outputs. Monitor and support all aspects of value engineering, including tracking changes and reconciling variations. Manage proper allocation of assets and liabilities by ensuring proper maintenance of project insurance requirements. Manage the elimination of potential risks and hazards by identifying elements of project design likely to result in claims or disputes. Participate in tendering processes to identify and report all potential discrepancies. Be involved in all Human Resource processes and procedures, including mobilization and demobilization. Manage cost planning, commercial management, value engineering, and contract administration at every phase of the process. dad0810e3b7ada3e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مستشفى دار الشفاء عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تشخيص وعلاج أمراض الفم والأسنان، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تجهيز وتركيب التعويضات السنية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحوصات السريرية للأسنان، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها لتشخيص حالات الفم والأسنان. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة وبرنامج زمني لكل حالة مرضية. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات السنية ومعالجة القنوات اللبية. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للمرضى. تطوير العمل والتوثيق المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بجميع أعمال طب وصحة الأسنان. المؤهلات والخبرة درجة البكالوريوس في طب الأسنان أو ما يعادلها. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام ضمن فريق طبي في مستشفى دار الشفاء بالرياض، في بيئة عمل احترافية تلتزم بأعلى معايير الرعاية الصحية وسلامة المرضى. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل.

dab9bcd1a5dd6f09.description: About Abunayyan Holding Abunayyan Holding is seeking an experienced Quality Supervisor to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on overseeing quality control within switchgear manufacturing operations. Role Overview The Quality Supervisor will be responsible for managing and ensuring the quality of switchgear products throughout the manufacturing lifecycle. This role involves leading quality control inspections, testing activities, and ensuring adherence to industry standards and customer specifications. Key Responsibilities Supervise quality control inspections and testing across the entire manufacturing process. Oversee incoming inspections, in-process testing, final inspections, and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT). Ensure compliance with customer specifications, internal quality procedures, and applicable industry standards. Lead and guide the quality team to achieve established quality objectives. Minimum of 10 years of experience in electrical quality control and testing within the switchgear manufacturing industry. Strong hands-on experience in QC processes, including in-process inspections, final testing, and FAT of switchgear. Knowledge of IEC standards is considered an advantage. Required Skills Proven leadership and team supervision capabilities. Strong communication, reporting, and documentation skills. Proficiency in English and MS Office applications. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply for this position.

daf49d303db2f8aa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بن لادن السعودية عن مدير عمليات أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة قيادة منظومة الأمن الشاملة، بهدف حماية الأفراد والممتلكات والمواقع من أي تهديدات محتملة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة واسعة في مجال العمليات الأمنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتطوير الخطط الأمنية الشاملة لضمان سلامة الأفراد والممتلكات. تقييم المخاطر الأمنية المحتملة ووضع استراتيجيات للتخفيف منها. إدارة عمليات الحراسة وتنظيم إجراءات الدخول والخروج للمواقع. الاستجابة الفورية والفعالة للحوادث الأمنية والتأكد من تطبيق البروتوكولات اللازمة. التنسيق المستمر مع الجهات الأمنية الداخلية والخارجية لتعزيز بيئة العمل الآمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة لا تقل عن 10 سنوات في مجال عمليات الأمن أو إدارة الأمن. سجل حافل في قيادة فرق الأمن وتطوير الاستراتيجيات الأمنية. فهم عميق لأفضل الممارسات في مجال الأمن والحماية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية قوية وقدرة على اتخاذ القرارات تحت الضغط. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم وإدارة الأزمات. قدرة على التواصل الفعال والتنسيق مع مختلف الأطراف. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير عمليات الأمن في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب اليقظة والجاهزية المستمرة. يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في مجموعة بن لادن السعودية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال مراحل المقابلة. ندعو المرشحين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم.

daea19085ae2d004.description: About the Role Office Solutions, a Dubai-based flooring company specializing in solutions for commercial, residential, and interior fit-out projects, is seeking a Business Development Executive. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on expanding the company's market presence and developing new business opportunities within the region. Establish relationships with main contractors, flooring contractors, consultants, developers, architects, and procurement teams. da654b3e132c7c75.description: Job description About the Position Galaxy Enterprises Services Co. is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Sales Engineer – Electrical & Chemical to join our team in Saudi Arabia. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering field , combined with experience in technical sales, business development, or industrial products . Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers and suppliers. Identify new business opportunities within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Utilities, Industrial, and Construction sectors. dadcf7e8ff5c44ee.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع عيادات الخزان الطبي في الرياض عن أخصائي مختبرات طبية للانضمام إلى فريقه. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة احتياجات المختبر من المواد، وإجراء التحاليل المخبرية، وإعداد التقارير الطبية اللازمة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في المجال. الهدف من الوظيفة تتمثل المهمة الأساسية لأخصائي المختبرات الطبية في تحديد وتوفير المواد الأولية اللازمة للفحوصات، واستلام العينات، وإجراء التحاليل المخبرية المطلوبة بدقة. كما يشمل الدور إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال المختبرات، مع ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد احتياجات المختبر من المواد الطبية، وتوفيرها، وتسجيلها، والتأكد من سلامتها وتعقيمها، ومراقبة فترة صلاحيتها. استلام عينات الفحص من المرضى وحفظها بالطرق السليمة، وإجراء التحاليل الكيميائية والفيزيائية والمجهرية للكشف عن السكر أو البروتين أو الجراثيم والطفيليات. دراسة نتائج الاختبارات وإعداد التقارير التفصيلية بشأنها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في أساليب التحاليل الطبية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالتحاليل للمرضى وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال المختبرات الطبية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المختبرات الطبية. القدرة على إجراء التحاليل والفحوصات المخبرية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بأساليب حفظ العينات والتعامل معها. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في العمل المخبري. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والطبية. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في بيئة المختبر. القدرة على مواكبة التطورات في مجال التحاليل الطبية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي المختبرات الطبية ضمن فريق مجمع عيادات الخزان الطبي في الرياض، في بيئة عمل تتطلب الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية والطبية الصارمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل.

dab3be521c274b88.description: تبحث شركة طواف لخدمات النقل عن سائق حافلة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين والزوار بأمان وفعالية، مع الالتزام التام بالمسارات والجداول الزمنية المعتمدة والتعليمات التشغيلية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنة إلى خمس سنوات في مجال القيادة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة لنقل الركاب بأمان وفقاً للمسارات والجداول المحددة. الالتزام بأنظمة المرور والسرعات المحددة، والقيادة بسلاسة لتجنب التوقف أو التجاوز المفاجئ. الامتناع التام عن استخدام الهاتف الجوال أثناء القيادة لضمان التركيز والسلامة. إجراء الفحص اليومي للشاحنة قبل الانطلاق، بما في ذلك الفرامل والإطارات والأنوار ومستوى الوقود. التأكد من جاهزية أجهزة السلامة مثل مطفأة الحريق وحقيبة الإسعافات الأولية. الإبلاغ الفوري عن أي أعطال ميكانيكية لمركز الصيانة. التقيد بجدول الرحلة ومواعيد التوقف والوصول بدقة. استقبال الركاب بأسلوب مهذب وتقديم المساعدة اللازمة لهم، خاصة كبار السن وذوي الإعاقة. التأكد من مطابقة تذاكر الركاب أو تصاريح الصعود للفئات المصرح لها فقط. الحفاظ على نظافة الحافلة وتشغيل التكييف والإضاءة المناسبة لراحة الركاب. تفقد الحافلة بعد كل رحلة للتأكد من خلوها من الركاب والتعامل مع أي مفقودات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنة إلى خمس سنوات كسائق. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول ( حافلة كبيرة ) . معرفة جيدة بأنظمة المرور والسلامة على الطرق. القدرة على التعامل مع الركاب بمهنية واحترام. الالتزام بالمواعيد والجدول الزمني للرحلات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة . تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية المحددة لضمان نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين والزوار بكفاءة وأمان. التقديم الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. للمهتمين، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة في مكة المكرمة.

And to make it happen, we’re reimagining everything about education: from cutting-edge tech to peer learning and physical spaces that spark curiosity. Hear about our vision directly from our CEO here. Learn more about us [here] The role You will be the one designer who owns the student experience. Primarily that means the student app: where students study, work with an AI tutor, answer questions, and take part in activities, including games and head-to-head duels on a topic. You will also shape parts of the live classroom experience. This is a Senior/Principal-level individual contributor Product Designer role. There is no design team underneath you and no manager drawing your roadmap. You take a problem from the first student conversation to the shipped screen, and you decide what to look at next. Why this role One owner of the whole student experience, with a direct line to leadership. Speed: with AI in the workflow, ideas go from research to release in days, not quarters. An experimentation practice being built from the ground up, with you shaping it. A company expanding into more schools, with a long-term ambition to match. What You Will Do Spend real time with students in Saudi schools. Interviews, focus groups, classroom observation. Turn what you hear into design decisions, and go back to check them. Design for Saudi Arabia, not for the generic "best practice" app. Patterns that work in London or San Francisco often fail here. You know why, and you can show it in your work. Own the student app end to end. Flows, information architecture, prototypes, final UI, and the handover to engineering. Design activities students want to come back to, games and duels included, with learning as the gate: an activity that is more fun but teaches less is a regression. Run experiments. State a hypothesis, build the variants, agree the metric, and read the result honestly. You will help build the experimentation practice, not just use it. Work AI-native. Use AI tools for generation, prototyping and production so your time goes to research and judgement. We care about the quality of your decisions, not how many pixels you pushed by hand. Work directly with the product manager and engineers. Short loops, fast releases, no layers. About you (To be successful in this role, you should have): Roughly 5 years of experience in UX, product design experience. We care less about the number and more about how many people you have interviewed and what you did with it. A research practice you can describe in detail: how you recruit, what you ask, how you synthesise, how it reached the product. A portfolio of projects that demonstrate your creativity and delivery of results through great consumer-facing mobile-first experiences Proficiency in using various tools and techniques to create and communicate your design ideas, such as sketches, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, etc. Experience in conducting user research and testing in different contexts and cultures, using both qualitative and quantitative methods A strong sense of empathy, curiosity, and creativity, and a willingness to learn and experiment Why Noon? Real impact — your work directly affects how thousands of students learn every day. Speed and autonomy — small team, big problems, zero bureaucracy. AI-native culture — we don't just talk about AI, we build with it daily. Well-funded — Series B closed, substantial recurring revenue, and accelerating. Mission that matters — every student deserves world-class teachers. We're making it happen. Benefits In addition to a competitive base salary, we offer: Performance-based bonus 21 days of annual leave Full premium Medical coverage, including Family Dependent Noon Academy is the #1 EdTech in MENAP, on a mission to radically change the way students learn. Founded in Riyadh in 2013, we've taught over 20 million students across five countries — and today we run Noon Tracks, hybrid micro-schools where a master teacher goes live across up to 20 classrooms at once, amplified by AI and peer-to-peer learning. Never study alone.

da73830ded936076.description: ARX is a global network of specialists in engineering, design, and architecture. Our team offers 360° consulting, project management, and technical services in: airports, bridges, buildings, cableways, digital innovation, environment, equipment, geology, geotechnics, hydropower, metros, nuclear plants, oil & gas, pipelines, ports, railways, river engineering, roads, traffic, tunnels, and water/wastewater treatment. Set the standard for BIM-enabled delivery: model-based interface checks, clash review, and disciplined CDE workflows. Work with the Project Manager and the planning and commercial teams so that design progress, programme, and fee expenditure stay aligned. Apply and enforce ARX's QA/QC regime (review checklists, design verification, and lessons learned) so that quality is built in rather than inspected in. Lead value engineering and technical option studies, including low-carbon and whole-life performance improvements aligned with Saudi Green Building Code and Vision 2030 sustainability targets, and quantify the benefit of each. Forecast design resource needs, allocate workload across the team, and mentor engineers within the design stream. Report design progress, risk, and interface status to ARX management and to the client, in writing and in person. Contribute to proposals, design delivery strategies, technical methodologies, and fee estimates for new opportunities. Minimum 12 years' relevant experience in design management, engineering management, or multidisciplinary design coordination, of which at least 5 in a lead design management role. Minimum 5 years of KSA experience is required, including direct exposure to Saudi authority approval processes such as MOMRAH / Balady, Saudi Civil Defense, the Royal Commission for Riyadh City (RCRC), the Ministry of Transport and Logistic Services, or the Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu, as well as giga-project client approval frameworks. Proven experience leading design on complex infrastructure, transport, buildings, or mixed-use assignments. Strong command of design-stage gateways, deliverable definition, design verification, and construction-stage design support. Solid knowledge of the Saudi Building Code (SBC) and KSA authority requirements alongside international standards such as BS, EN, AASHTO, or ASHRAE. Experience with BIM-enabled design coordination and CDE / document-control platforms such as ACONEX, Autodesk Construction Cloud, or SharePoint. Excellent written and verbal English is required; Arabic language capability is a strong advantage. Chartered status (CEng, PE, or equivalent) or professional membership of ICE, IStructE, RIBA, or CIOB is preferred; PMP is an advantage. Professional accreditation with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE), or eligibility to obtain it, is required. We Offer: Opportunity to collaborate with a forward-thinking, synergistic, and innovative team. Exposure to cutting-edge projects driving Middle East / North African regions development. Personalized professional growth and developmental avenues tailored to your career aspirations. If you would you like to join our highly motivated and very successful team please send us your complete application! Sector: Construction / Civil Engineering Role: Engineering / Design Engineering Job type: Permanent job

dad8fcb655a1541f.description: Inbox Business Technologies is seeking an experienced, Arabic-speaking Senior BCM Consultant to lead business continuity workstreams for a regulated telecommunications infrastructure client in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The engagement involves reviewing and refreshing a mature BCM program: updating governance documentation, validating the Business Impact Analysis (BIA) methodology, executing the BIA across multiple business sectors, developing sector-level Business Continuity Plans (BCPs), and aligning the wider BCM documentation set with the Communications, Space and Technology Commission (CST) Business Continuity Management Regulations and ISO 22301. Employment Type: Full-time employment Key Responsibilities BIA facilitation: lead BIA introductory sessions, facilitation clinics and validation workshops with business sector representatives; review, challenge and validate departmental submissions; consolidate results to identify critical processes, recovery objectives (RTO, RPO, MAO), dependencies and single points of failure. Business continuity planning: run recovery strategy workshops and develop sector-level BCPs on the client's templates, covering roles, activation and escalation protocols, recovery procedures and communications. Governance and methodology: contribute to gap assessments of the BCM Framework and BIA methodology against ISO 22301, CST BCM regulatory requirements and regulator audit findings; draft tracked-change updates and compliance traceability matrices. Artefact alignment: review and update crisis management and communication plans, emergency response plans, IT DR plan templates and regulator readiness response templates (e.g. Hajj and Ramadan) for consistency with the updated framework and plans. Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Information Technology, Risk Management or a related field. Minimum 6–8 years of BCM experience, including hands-on delivery of BIAs and BCPs end to end. Recognized business continuity certification, such as BCI CBCI / MBCI, DRII CBCP / MBCP, or ISO 22301 Lead Implementer. Business-level fluency in Arabic and English (spoken and written), with the ability to facilitate workshops in either language. Proven experience delivering BCM engagements in regulated telecommunications or critical infrastructure environments in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Working knowledge of the CST Business Continuity Management Regulations and ISO 22301, ISO 22313 and ISO/TS 22317. Strong workshop facilitation skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders. Excellent report-writing skills, including policy, methodology and plan documentation. Available to work for the full duration of the engagement. Experience addressing regulator audit findings and BCM maturity assessments in KSA. Experience with crisis management, emergency response and IT disaster recovery documentation. Experience designing and facilitating tabletop exercises (ISO 22398). Familiarity with enterprise risk management frameworks and aligning BIA impact scales with ERM. Additional certifications such as ISO 22301 Lead Auditor, CRISC or PMP. Structured, analytical thinking with attention to detail and consistency. Ability to challenge business inputs constructively and drive decisions. Ownership of quality and deadlines in a fast-paced, fixed-schedule engagement. Cultural awareness and professional presence in client-facing settings. Team player who can coach junior consultants and work with remote support staff.

da115a37e7eccf56.description: Job Description The Turbine & Precision Equipment Rigger is responsible for executing highly critical, heavy, and precision lifting operations during power plant turbine outages and industrial maintenance shutdowns.
